Frontend InteractiveCoachingPanel component renders correctly with data-testid='interactive-coaching-panel' and displays coach move explanation, 'Your turn!' prompt, threats, and hints.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Interactive Coaching Panel feature fully verified. The POST /api/coach/play/v5/interactive-feedback endpoint returns {user_move_coaching, coach_move_coaching, is_user_turn}. The InteractiveCoachingPanel component in /app/frontend/src/components/shared/InteractiveCoachingPanel.jsx renders correctly with data-testid='interactive-coaching-panel'. It shows three sections: UserMoveSection (feedback on user's move), CoachMoveSection (explanation of coach's move with plan, threats, teaching_point), and YourTurnSection (prompt for user's next move with hints). The component is integrated into CoachPlay.jsx at line 2736.
